title: Part request refusals about the Part Library use Part Library wording
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-REQMSG-01) is active at {Location-A}, so it is also a Part Library entry.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) is open, for a ZZAUTOTEST customer, with a line {Line-1} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL request message line").
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Work Orders.
  2. Open {Work-order-1}.
  3. In the Parts row of {Line-1} click + Add Part.
  4. In New Part Request, type {Part-A} in Part Number.
  5. Pick the result whose source reads "Part Library".
  6. Read the Source and Category fields.
  7. Click Save Part.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 6: Source and Category are filled in for the part picked from the Part Library.
  • Step 7: The part request is saved on {Line-1} with no error message.
  • Steps 5 to 7: The two refusals "Part Library entry missing category." and "A part from the Part Library must have Vendor as its source." (red error toasts that close after about 3 seconds) belong to requests that reach the system with no category or with another source, which this screen does not send: write "refusal wording not checked by hand" in the result comment.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10825 (Story 12, Call the Shared Parts List the Part Library); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S12-R11, §8 User Feedback Summary, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 6.1 (While active: GREASETUBE is found), board 6.2 (Once inactive: not offered), 13 Oct copy. Tech plan "Parts Lifecycle Update — Technical Implementation Plan" (7 Oct 2026), §1 Clarifications Q9. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-R11: “Refusals that name the shared list read: "This Part Library entry is in use and cannot be deleted.", "Part Library entry not found.", "Part Library entry not found", "Part Library entry not found for ID: {id}.", "Part Library entry not found for part number: {part number}.", "Part Library entry missing category." and "A part from the Part Library must have Vendor as its source."”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Part request from a Part Library entry with no category): “"Part Library entry missing category." | Error toast, fades after 3 seconds”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Part request from a Part Library entry with a source other than Vendor): “"A part from the Part Library must have Vendor as its source." | Error toast, fades after 3 seconds”
  • Tech plan §1 Clarifications (Q9 S12-R11 copy): “the Vendor-source message is kept and renamed”
